title: Avoid shell interpretation of untrusted values
summary: Programs must not pass untrusted values through a shell because metacharacters can change the executed command.
review_checks: Find shell execution APIs and shell-enabled subprocess calls.
Trace whether arguments can originate from a request, file, environment, or external service.
safe_tests: Test only in a local disposable environment with harmless marker arguments.
Confirm the program passes an argument array without shell parsing.
remediation: Use direct process APIs with a fixed executable and argument array.
Remove the shell dependency or map user choices to a fixed allowlist.
